name: Choi Ero Banchou
original_name: ちょい エロ 番長
source:
"Want to try to have a more stimulating love... with me?"
A mysterious Banchou who can say his slightly embarrassing theory "Ero is essential for love" in a loud voice.
He claims to be Sexy Banchou's younger brother.
